title: Inkk 0.1.2
release_notes:
What's new in Inkk v0.1.2:
- Ultimate Zero-Lag Handwriting: Dynamic stroke shape caching, Bezier curve step optimization, and redundant ribbon edge elimination completely remove inking hitches
- Viewport-Clamped Paper Grids: Frustum-culled background ruled lines and dot-grids prevent unnecessary geometry on large pages
- High-Speed Previews Drawer: Cached page thumbnail shapes eliminate thumbnail re-rendering while writing
- Non-blocking Background Autosave: Background worker thread saves notebooks without blocking user pen strokes
- Whiteboard-native Flowcharting: Place and edit flowchart blocks directly on the canvas without dialog popups
- Interactive Anchor Connection Dots: Hover connection dots appear on block edges; clicking an anchor auto-connects to the next block with an arrow
- Precision Lasso Selection: Enclosure ratio and centroid filtering to accurately select individual strokes
- Clean launch: Set Windows GUI subsystem to permanently eliminate the background command prompt (cmd) window
